race.title: Unibet London Middle Distance Series (Final) Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: This series final can go the way of TRYFAN , who did well to get as close as he did when runner-up here 6 weeks ago. With the potential for plenty of pace in this race, he is fancied to reverse the placings with War Hawk from when the pair met last time, King's Code completing the shortlist as he bids to land this prize for a second year running. TRYFAN WAR HAWK (IRE) KING'S CODE
